Hopeless Suitor: He instantly falls in love with Charmcaster upon seeing her in "Charmed, I'm Sure", spending most of the episode pining for her to no avail.

characters.name: Molly Gunther
characters.description: One of the few recurring female plumbers and a member of Alpha Squad. Badass Normal: She takes on Proctor Servantis, a Plumber with more experience and cerebral crustacian powers, and wins. Eyepatch of Power: AFreeze-Frame Bonusin "End of an Era" shows her in Ben 10,000's time with a patch over her right eye. Mauve Shirt: Despite wearing red she's long-lived and gets some characterization. No Celebrities Were Harmed: Resembles and has a name similar toHolly Hunter.

characters.name: Magister Labrid
characters.description: A Plumber officer, and one of Max's friends. He shows up inAlien Force's pilot episode to investigate the Highbreed invasion and help Ben find Max.He gets killed, and leaves to Ben the mission to end the invasion. Alien Blood: If his "that's not water" is to be taken at its direst, his species has neon blue blood that steams on contact with at least Earth's atmosphere. Berserk Button: Magister Labrid takes the usage of alien technology very seriously. Seeing Forever Knights trading Level 5 tech and beyond that by all rights shouldn't be on Earth seemed to make him snap, causing him to break his cover and declare all the Forever Knights and theDNAliensthey're dealing with to be under arrest. Conspicuous Trenchcoat: Magister Labrid's human disguise wears one of these, along with a form-fitting hat. Heroic Sacrifice:He ends up damaging his suit while saving Kevin from a sure death, leading to his own demise.

characters.name: Magister Prior Gihil
characters.description: The Plumber officer in charge of the sector where Earth is located during the UAF era. Back for the Dead:He comes back inUltimate Alienonly to be killed by Aggregor. By-the-Book Cop: His first appearance depicts him as a stickler to the rules, refusing to give any leniency to Ben's team and accusing them of impersonating Plumbers, despite their protests that they are defending Earth against an alien invasion. He very nearly arrests the heroes had Darkstar not decided to reveal himself as the true culprit. Four-Star Badass: In this caseMagisterBadass; the Officer in charge of the entire sector. Also a pretty good fighter capable of easily defeating Kevin. Genre Blindness: While you can't blame him for being skeptical about the Highbreed invasion due to not having any proof, he doesn't even botherinvestigatinghimself to make sure. He also doesn't both to check the source of his tip to make sure he isn't walking into a trap.He gets better byUltimate Alien, where, when receiving a distress call from Aggregor's ship and being given a flimsy excuse by Aggregor to justify it, he decides to still give it a look just in case.Sadly,this ends up costing him his life.

characters.name: Scout
characters.description: A Loboan Plumber operating on Anur Transyl, and one of Rook's former classmates. He serves as their ally during their visit to Anur Transyl in theGalactic Monstersstory arc. Ascended Fanboy: Much like Rook, he read a lot about Ben while studying in the Plumber Academy, and was inspired by him into becoming a Plumber. My Species Doth Protest Too Much: He doesn’t share theFantastic Racismmost of Anur Transyl’s inhabitants have toward outsiders, and in fact calls them out for it when they act hostile toward Ben. Nice Guy: In contrast to Rad. Noble Wolf: A wolf-like alien, and firmly on the side of good.

characters.name: Luhley
characters.description: Badass Adorable: Manages to be cute and competent at the same time. Non-Standard Character Design: Her head is more triangular than other Galvans. Official Couple: With Driba. Only Sane Man: Compared to Blukic and Driba, she's much more mature than them. Took a Level in Kindness: The next time we see her, she's more tolerable of Blukic and Driba's antics and doesn't show any slight annoyance of them. This may have to do with the issue about the Skeuomorph being resolved.

characters.name: The Magistrata
characters.description: Da Chief: She's the single highest ranked Plumber in the universe. Deus ex Machina: Her one and only appearance in the series so far has been to show up and endthe Rootersas a danger by revoking their Plumber commission and having all their equipment confiscated, leaving them stranded and bereft of all the resources that made them a major threat.

characters.name: Doctor Animo
characters.description: Arch-Enemy: He's considered to be Ben's third most important nemesis, preceded only byVilgaxandKevin 11(the episode "Ben 10,000" even had him as theBig Badof the future and responsible for Vilgax's resurrection). This doesn't appear to have carried past the Original Series, with Animo's less frequent appearances and Ben's increasingly lower opinion on him, with Ben even calling him a B-List villain inOmniverse. The Beastmaster: Of his own, he has little to no fighting skills, especially against someone as powerful as Ben. But he usually has an entire army of mutated animals at his beck and call, so it doesn't really matter. Better with Non-Human Company: He has a borderline misanthropic attitude towards other humans, and is only civil towards his animal companions. Even when he's in prison, he rambles away to some seagulls over his fellow inmates.Omniverseshows that when he doesn't have any animals with him, he grows despondent and needs stuffed toys for companionship, which he hallucinates are real. Dude, Where's My Reward?: The whole reason behind hisStart of Darknesswas the fact that he didn't get a Verity Award (because of his immoral experiments), which he believed he greatly deserved. Even Evil Has Loved Ones: While Animo is no doubt an awful person who experiments on animals, he does have affection for his mutant creations. He's often seen talking to, caressing, and comforting them like anyone would for their beloved pet. When he's detained in a Plumber cell without their company, he steadily loses his mind and uses stuffed animals to fill in the void.

characters.name: Hex
characters.description: A powerfulEvil Sorcerer, and Charmcaster's uncle. Hex mostly serves as Gwen'sArch-Enemyrather than Ben's. He seeks to conquer the world with the power of the Charms of Bezel. He hails from Ledgerdomain. Abusive Parents: He is Charmcaster's uncle and guardian, and he mistreats her terribly, whichcomes back to bite him. He grows out of this byAlien Forceand comes to genuinely love her and wants to live with her peacefully. Arch-Enemy: Comes to see Gwen (or rather, "Lucky Girl") as this, though from a story perspective,her rivalCharmcaster fits the role better. He was her nemesis until Charmcaster took over the role. Butt-Monkey: Every episode featuring Hex has him suffer a comically humiliating defeat. His first appearance has him lose his charms, then get shoved in a coffin. Second has him double crossed by his own niece, then get his magical energy drained. By his third showing he's been reduced to a frail old man and seeks theFountain of Youthto make him young again...only to be regressed back to a child and helpless in Charmcaster's care. You can't really blame him for retiring. Dark Is Evil: His mana has very dark colours to match his evil personality.

characters.name: Charmcaster
characters.description: InUltimate Alien, it's revealed that her true name is Hope and that she comes from the dimension of Ledgerdomain. Her father and all other humans save for her and Hex were slaughtered by the evil Addwaitya, who conquered the realm for himself. Hope's goal is to liberate her homeworld and also find a way to resurrect her father, no matter what the cost may be, and she thus walks the line between good and evil frequently. Arch-Enemy: To Gwen. She overtook this role from Hex. Bastard Understudy: To Hex, whom she learned both magic and villainy from. Black Magician Girl: She's a magical girl with a very brash personality, and a rare villainous example of the trope. Breakout Villain: Was initially introduced in "Tough Luck" as a sidekick for Hex. ByOmniverse, she had far more episodes,Character Developmentand interactions with Gwen than Hex ever had.

characters.name: Forever Knights
characters.description: Forever King Driscoll

characters.name: Retaliator
characters.description: A mysterious Galvanic Mechamorph, who arrives on Earth with the mission of eradicating all extraterrestrials that cross his path. All There in the Manual: His name is never given in the movie, "Retaliator" comes from the promotional materials leading up to its release and later toys. Color-Coded for Your Convenience: HisTron Linesare blue, setting him apart from Upgrade's green and Malware's red/yellow as notable Galvanic Mechamorphs. Luke, I Am Your Father: His true identity isAzmuth's father, come to avenge his son for his supposed death. Monumental Damage: He first attacks Ben at Stonehenge which totals it, and narrowly avoids doing the same to the Giza Pyramids and theCristo Redentor. He's particularly unconcerned about the first case, dismissing it as a galvan practical joke and thus not worth attempting to preserve.

characters.name: Zs'Skayr
characters.description: Zs'Skayr (pronounced Zuh-Scare) was theEvil Overlordruler of the planet Anur Phaetos, and the Ectonurite who provided the DNA sample for Ben's alien form known as Ghostfreak. Due to his species, the Ectonurites, possessing the ability to retain their consciousness even in the slightest part of their DNA, Zs'Skayr's mind survived inside the Omnitrix, eventually trying to take over Ben, andended up escaping the Omnitrix. Since then, he has become obsessed with taking over Ben's body so he can get the Omnitrix's powers. Abnormal Limb Rotation Range: In the first two series, his skull was upside-down.Omniversereveals that he, and all members of his species, have the ability to rotate their skulls. All There in the Manual: His name, true identity and backstory were all revealed through trivia pop-ups in the original series andAlien Force. In-series, everyone always referred to him as Ghostfreak, and it took untilOmniversefor his real identity to be even mentioned by the characters. Ambiguous Situation: Despite Zs'Skayr being an exact copy of the original, we never see what he was like before being trapped in the Omnitrix. The two never meet either, so it's possible the original passed away a long time ago. Arch-Enemy: The fourth contender for the title, right behind Vilgax and Kevin, while tying with Dr. Animo. His origin as one of Ben's aliens make him a rather personal foe and he is considered by fans to be one of the most iconic villains. Following Kevin turning good, Zs'Skayr has safely moved to third place, or perhaps even second due to Ben's low opinion on Animo and citing him as a B-List villain.

characters.name: Dr. Viktor
characters.description: Dr. Viktor is a Transylian scientist, and one of Zs'Skayr's minions. His DNA was scanned when he grabbed Ben by the wrist, unlocking Frankenstrike. Back from the Dead: The original Dr. Viktor was killed by Kevin inUltimate Alien, and his body was taken over by King Xarion of Zarkovia. InOmniverse, Zs'Skayr devours Xarion's soul, killing him off, and reviving the original Viktor. Blood Knight: Once freed in "Rad Monster Party", he remarks that one of the things he missed most was punching things. The Dragon: To Zs'Skayr,until "The Vampire Strikes Back". Of course, Lord Transyl already took over this role beforehand. Dragon-in-Chief: As Zs'Skayr is dead for most of Season 3, Viktor and his purple lightning serve as the actual main antagonist of the season until he succeeds in bringing Zs'Skayr back to life.

characters.name: Werewolf
characters.description: A minion of Zs'Skayr, belonging to a werewolf-like species known as Loboans. He also unlocked Blitzwolfer via scratching the Omnitrix. Animals Lack Attributes: Like most of Ben's aliens, he doesn't have any package. Dark Is Evil: Not all Loboans are evil, but he sure is. Flat Character: The Loboan never speaks and doesn't display any personality beyond being loyal to Zs'Skayr. Flower Mouth: Like the rest of his species, his jaws can split open this way for his supersonic howl.

characters.name: The Mummy
characters.description: A minion of Zs'Skayr belonging to a mummy-like alien species called Thep Khufans. He was tasked with gathering Corrodium for Zs'Skayr's plan, and he unlocked Ben's Thep Khufan transformation, Snare-oh, when he touched the Omnitrix. Combat Tentacles: The bandages that make up his body actually are thin, but very strong tentacles he has complete control over. They can be used to effortlessly lift Diamondhead. Dark Is Evil: Not all Thep Khufans are, but he certainly is. Flat Character: Like the Loboan, the Mummy never speaks, and his entire character is defined by being a loyal servant to Zs'Skayr. Mummy: His look is based on one, though otherwise it follows almost none of the clichés usually associated with the trope.

characters.name: Rojo
characters.description: The leader of a female biker gang who committed thefts. During a confrontation with Ben and one of Vilgax's drones, she investigated the drone's remains, causing them to fuse with her and turn into a cyborg. Though she initially attempted to use her newfound powers for crime, it quickly turned out she had no power over them. Vilgax then contacted her and forced her to chase Ben for him. All Bikers Are Hells Angels: She's the leader of a biker gang that commits armed robberies, andshoots the Tennysons out of annoyance just forlooking at her. All There in the Script: Her real name, Joey, is only listed in the credits of her debut episode and on an official trading card. Amazon Brigade: She leads an all-female biker gang in both her debut and herUltimate Aliencameo. Ax-Crazy: She is a violent sociopath who will open fire onchildrenandthe elderlyjust for looking at her the wrong way.

characters.name: Clancy
characters.description: A mysterious, blue-skinned man with the ability to control arthropods. When first introduced, Clancy kidnapped a councilwoman who was attempting to destroy the house where he was living, intending to feed her to his bug friends. Ben saved her, but destroyed the building in the process, killing many of the bugs. Infuriated, Clancy replied by attempting to destroy the whole city. Amazing Technicolor Population: He isblue. Anti-Villain: Type II in his first appearance; while he was relying on murderous methods, all he wanted was to protect his home. Beard of Evil: Shaped like mendibles, no less. The Beastmaster: He has an empathetic link with arthropods and can use them for fighting purposes.

characters.name: Circus Freak Trio
characters.description: A trio of clown-based superpowered criminals who were working as Zombozo's henchmen in hisCircus of Fearin his first appearance. Their role was to steal everything in the city while he fed on people's joy during his show. After Zombozo was defeated by Ben, they lost track of him, and started working of their own, with a personal grudge toward Ben. They became recurring antagonists during the original series, but disappeared in the Alien Force era (ironically, Zombozo himself would later be brought back). Their group consisted of:Acid Breath, a guy with the ability spit acid from his mouth;Frightwig, a girl withCombat Tentaclesas her hair; andThumbskull, theirDumb Muscle. Acid Attack: Acid Breath, as his name suggests, can breathe and spit out acid. Body Horror: Acid Breath's face. Seriously, just look at the pic. Breath Weapon: Acid Breath. As suggested by his name.

characters.name: Sublimino
characters.description: A man short in both size and temper with hypnotic powers who used them to control people and force them to accomplish crimes for his profit. Clock of Power: His primary weapon, which he uses to hypnotize his minions. Dirty Coward: Immediately attempts to hightail it the minute he runs out of hypnotized minions to fight. Evil Is Hammy: Well, heisa stage hypnotist turned supervillain. Good Scars, Evil Scars: It's hard to tell due to his glasses, but he has a distinctive lightning-shaped scar on the right eye.

characters.name: Sotoraggian Bounty Hunters
characters.description: TwoJango/Boba Fett-esquealienBounty Hunterswithunknown alien languagewho regularly show up.SixSixwas introduced in the original series as a hunter hired by Vilgax to get the Omnitrix. He then got several appearances as a minor villain in the show, the last being inSecret of the Omnitrixas a minion of Vilgax.SevenSevenwas introduced in theAlien Force, andbasically played a similar role for this era. The two of them return inOmniverse, with a new character,EightEight, introduced as their sister. All There in the Manual: BeforeAlien Force, pop-up trivia in the first series confirmedSevenSeven's existence, explaining that they're brothers (withSevenSevenobviously being the elder). They also have a sister namedEightEight, whose existence was first confirmed by Derrick J. Wyatt. Arm Cannon:SixSixandEightEightuse blasters, butSevenSevencan turn both of his arms into blasters.SixSixsometimes displays a small rocket launcher that he flips up from one of his wrists. The Baby of the Bunch:TwoTwo, who is the youngest of them. Badass Family: WhileSevenSevenis less tough than his siblings, all three are strong opponents in their own right. Presumably this includesTwoTwoas well when she comes of age.

characters.name: Vulkanus
characters.description: An alienCon Manwho was first introduced working together withSixSix, and served as a minor villain in the original show. He shows up again in theAlien Force/Ultimate Alienera, where it's revealed that he is actually a dwarfish alien in a robotic suit. Bullying a Dragon: In "Con of Rath", upon seeing recognizing Ben in Rath form, he mocks him by asking if he "put the Omnitrix on ugly". Granted, he couldn't necessarily know how violent Rath was, but mocking the guy wearing the most powerful weapon in the universe and who already defeated him several times before? Not the smartest move... Characterization Marches On: The original series depicted him as aDumb Muscle(Synaptak specifically refers to him as "All brawn, no brain"), had him almost always teaming up withSixSix, and didn't really develop his personality. In theAlien Force/Ultimate Alienera, he usually worked on his own, led his own minions, and was smart enough to develop his own business. Con Man: As noted in his description, this is his main job. Doesn't mean he's good at it, though. Dumb Muscle: He is described as this in his first appearance. In his later appearances, however, he is portrayed as slightly smarter than before (enough to have his own business). Of course, most of his appearances are comical, and he still isn't very bright.

characters.name: Kraab
characters.description: An alienBounty Hunter, first introduced as one of the people sent by Vilgax to get the Omnitrix. Arrogant Kung-Fu Guy: He taunts Ben throughout their fight and is much more brash than his fellow hunters. Cyborg: The large majority of his body is a mechanical, crab-like shell. Deadpan Snarker: In his first appearance, he's constantly making quips, mostly atSixSix. Full-Conversion Cyborg: Appears to be a large robot, but pop-up trivia reveals he lost his body in a war on his home planet.

characters.name: Zombozo
characters.description: A mysteriousMonster Clownwho used to lead aCircus of Fear, making people laugh so he could use a machine to feed on their happiness while his minions were robbing the city. Ascended Extra: He was a one-shot villain in the original series, but was eventually brought back inUltimate Alienfor one more episode and then became a recurring villain inOmniverse. Awesome, but Impractical: How one could describe his nightmare powers. He is able to reach apparentlyReality Warperlevels of power with enough souls, but he requires a large amount of souls and a giant machine to do so. Without either, rubber arms aside, he is (technically) a normal man. Ax-Crazy: InUltimate Alien, he tried to kill Ben's mother in a very sadistic way while Gwen was watching. And it's clearly implied he buried someone at the beginning of the same episode. Bald of Evil: His top hat hides it, but he’s got no hair on his scalp.

characters.name: Exo-Skull
characters.description: Exo-Skull hails from Ben 10,000's time period. He is a cybernetically enhanced Rhino/Human hybrid created by Dr. Animo, and part of a gang of human/animal hybrids. All There in the Manual: Most of the information about his backstory, such as Dr. Animo creating him and him belonging to a gang of similar animal/human hybrids, were revealed through a trivia pop-up. Ascended Extra: He made a brief appearance in the original series and a cameo at Psyphon's auction inOmniversebefore becoming a recurring villain in the Time War arc. Even Evil Has Loved Ones: He does love his girlfriend Subdora and is very patient with her and supportive of her need for artistic expression, giving her two chances to do things her way before he does the job his way.Exo-Skull:I support you unconditionally and respect your need for artistic expression. But from now on, we're gonna do this job my way! Force and Finesse: He's the force to Subdora's finesse.

characters.name: Kangaroo Commando
characters.description: The creator of Kangaroo Commando, as well as the twin brother of its main actor. He later created Super Alien Hero Buddy Adventures only for Tim Dean to take the credit, and being passed over for credit and praise yet again drove him into villainy. Cain and Abel: Kane North and Abel North. Identical Twin Mistake: He avoids scrutiny as a suspect because he's such an unknown, people assume he's Abel. The audience on the other hand doesn't even know Abel has a twin until Kane reveals himself as the villain. No Celebrities Were Harmed: He and his brother are based onAdam West, in name and characterization. A Sinister Clue: Inverted, Tim Dean is left-handed so Kane's right-handedness clears him as a suspect.

characters.name: Jonah
characters.description: A supposedly benign wildlife preservationist, but actually a poacher using it as a cover to hunt rare and even extraterrestrial creatures. Evil Poacher: His schtick, stealing Kraken eggs to sell to the highest bidder. Meaningful Name: He's named after a portmanteau of Herman Melville (the author ofMoby-Dick) and Jonah (fromThe Bible), both of whom have a strong connection to giant sea creatures. Villain Decay: He was never one of Ben's biggest foes, but in his debut appearance he runs a whole poaching organization hunting a Kraken's eggs and breaks out aMini-Mechawhen fighting Ripjaws. When he shows up again in the comics, he's on his own poaching marmots fromJellystone Parkand the grand total of his armament is a single taser... which he ends uphitting himself with. Villain with Good Publicity: A very thin veneer of it. He successfully poses as a conservationist when talking with the Tennysons, but once Gwen has cause to go digging she uncovers his real reputation in short order.

characters.name: Krakken
characters.description: A mysterious aquatic monster. Ambiguously Related: It has teeth and eyesverysimilar to a Pisciss Volann, Ripjaw's species (the more anglerfish-like ones, rather than catfish-like, akin to Magister Pike or Patelliday), suggesting some connection, given how Ripjaws was able to stare it down, and when Shaw captured him, he claimed he'd caught a "baby Krakken". Combat Tentacles: It has a pair of tentacles flanking its mouth. Apparently they're retractable but we never see it onscreen. Kraken and Leviathan: Named after the Kraken, though body-wise it looks more like aStock Ness Monster. Monster Is a Mommy: The reason she's so aggressive is because Jonah's stealing her eggs.

characters.name: The Limax
characters.description: A group of shapeshifting aliens that plan to abduct humans as a food source. All There in the Manual: According to a trivia popup, they'll one day return for the Limax Wars of 2017 and cost Grandpa Max an arm. Blob Monster: They're green aliens capable of contorting their body in any shape or form, and are apparently made of a goo-like material. Capture and Replicate: Their whole plan is to capture every old person in the neighborhood to eat, while progressively replacing them so no one will suspect a thing. Cover-Blowing Superpower: They tend to break out a much greater degree of strength, flexibility, and general athletic and acrobatic prowess than would be expected of the senior citizens they pose as. It doesn't help that their hydrophobia means they'll do this on reflex, practically abandoning their cover to get away from it.

characters.name: The Great One
characters.description: A giant alien tick that lands in Yellowstone and begins to de-terraform the world as it feeds on the planet. Expy: It takes cues from other planet eaters, particularly Marvel's Galactus andTransformers's Unicron. Make My Monster Grow: It grows as it eats, becoming distinctly larger over the course of the episode and messily molting its old body. Non-Action Guy: It doesn't fight itself, it just sits there and eats the planet while its followers handle all the actual fighting. Not that it seems to notice there's fighting, or that it has followers. No Ontological Inertia: When it dies, the hellscape it transformed Yellowstone into reverts immediately to a pristine natural park... except for the goo it splattered onto the Rustbucket in its death throes, which Ben has to clean.

characters.name: Slix Vigma
characters.description: An antagonistic robot who abducts aliens throughout the galaxy and forces them to fight each other to death. Gladiator Games: He hosts them. Heel–Face Return: InOmniverse, he hosts a fighting tournament instead of kidnapping random aliens. Impaled with Extreme Prejudice: How he bites it, courtesy of Kevin 11 with his Petrosapien arm. Robotic Psychopath: It's never revealed who built him or how he got where he is but for all intent it seems his function is to host barbaric death games with captured gladiators.

characters.name: Ah Puch
characters.description: The supposed Mayan god of death. The Tennysons encountered him on a rather pointless adventure to stop the Forever Knights from claiming what he was guarding: the "Sword of Ekhuaj". Ah Puch stands out as one of Ben's stranger foes, as he's a figure from real-world mythology who doesn't seem to fit anywhere in theBen 10universe. Adaptational Heroism: WhileEverybody Hates Hades, here his only job is guarding the sword from intruders, including evil-doers like the Forever Knights. Adaptational Wimp: Despite being a god over life and death, Ah Puch doesn't display any real otherworldly power other than super-strength and agility, and gets trounced in combat by Four-Arms, a 10 year old boy in the form of a mortal alien. Everybody Hates Hades: While not as evil here, Ah Puch is still a violent, angry monster whose willing to kill anyone who comes near his charge, good intentions or no. Flat Character: He has no characterization, never speaks, doesn't distinguish friend from foe, and in the end is nothing more than a glorified obstacle for Ben to fight.

characters.name: The Mycelium
characters.description: A fungal overmind controlling an ever-growing forest and army of fungi. Achilles' Heel: Fungicides. A bottle of athlete's foot powder is enough to put it down for good. All There in the Manual: Bandai trading cards name it Fungal Brain and its minions Fungal Force. Fungus Humongous: They Mycelium itself is the size of a building, and it's merely part of a massive fungal forest. Logical Weakness: Foot powder, which can deal with itchy feet, caused by fungal infection. Turns out that it can killanyfungus, as Ben was able to throw his foot powder-filled shoe into its mouth to destroy it from the inside.

characters.name: Tentacle Troopers
characters.description: Squid-like alien machines living in the Bermuda Triangle. Ambiguous Situation: While they're held responsible for the disappearances of the Bermuda Triangle, we never actually find outwhy. Flat Character: They don't get much characterization beyond showing up and attacking.

characters.name: Kenko
characters.description: The main villain of the Sumo Slammers video game that Ben and Gwen end up stuck inside. Bilingual Bonus: Depending on how his name is written in Japanese, it can mean "Health, Strong, Child". The Cameo: As a fictional character he reappears a few times in Alien Force and Omniverse in various Sumo Slammers games that Ben plays. Cessation of Existence: Essentially the fate of Kenko the Ben 10 villain. Once Ben and Gwen escape the game and it resets, the version of Kenko made sentient and aware of the real world ceases to be, replaced once more with the standard fictional video game antagonist. Enemy Mine: Apparently by the time of Alien Force, he's teamed up with Ishiyama.

characters.name: S.A.M.
characters.description: A weather monitoring machine that later goes haywire. Achilles' Heel: The right sonic frequency is able to short him out and cause his constructed body to collapse. A.I.-cronym: Short forSoundingAnemometerMetagraphy, since he hasWeather Manipulationabilities. Card-Carrying Villain: Openly mocks his creator about how he plans to make the Great Chicago Fire look like a candle and in general gleefully gloats about the destruction he'll cause. Elemental Embodiment: His power over weather allows him to craft these as bodies. First a water monster, then a living lightning storm, and finally a tornado before absorbing enough material to become a sludge monster with features of all the other three.

characters.name: Road Crew
characters.description: A trio of road pirates aiming to destroy an interstate and make sure they have plenty of victims. Home Field Advantage: Baron Highway falls victim to it after stealing the Rustbucket. While itisa highly advanced vehicle packed full of alien tech, it's also... well, a rustbucket, and Ben takes full advantage of that to wreak havoc on him. Karma Houdini:Word of Godis that they're still robbing people after the episode. Sliding Scale of Villain Threat: Notably on the low end of the scale since they appear in the final season of the original series. Unlike the evil sorcerers, interplanetary conquerors, and alien monsters that Ben had fought by then, they're just three normal humans who want to wreck a highway.

characters.name: Mr. Beck
characters.description: A mobster extorting a pair of mutants for their underground wrestling winnings. The Mafia: He's the only mundane crime lord seen throughout the series.

characters.name: Comics Villains
characters.description: Monster of the Week: They're one-off villains for Ben to fight in the tie-in comics. Anti-Villain: He just wanted to put on a good show and pump his reputation a bit. The robot rampage was due to negligence, not malice. Murderous Malfunctioning Machine: His robot bull goes berserk pretty much the instant it's turned on. Obviously Evil: He didn't change his name when he made a rampaging robot, he already called himself Chaos. The Unfought: Ben never fights him directly, just his bull. Chaos himself is arrested by ordinary cops.

characters.name: Alien Force
characters.description: Big Bad: He returns as the main antagonist of Season 3. Big Bad Duumvirate: With Albedo in the finale, though it doesn't last long as Vilgax betrays him. BFS: It can shoot beams, cut through diamond and coat itself with flames or crystals, among other things. Enemy Mine: With Ben in "Ghost Town", to free his planet. However, when Zs'Skayr took over Ben, Vilgax did attempt to kill both Ben and Zs'Skayr at the same time. Even Evil Has Standards:Subverted; his respect of the Galactic Code in "Vengeance of Vilgax" was, if anything,Pragmatic Villainy, as it allowed him to easily conquer 10 worlds without wasting any resources and gain several new powers in the process; plus, in the following episodes, he hasno problembreaking said code.

characters.name: Ultimate Alien
characters.description: Contrived Coincidence: His resemblance to Dagon, which he takes advantage of. Deal with the Devil: He makes a deal with Dagon, anEldritch Abomination, to free it fromits canin exchange for the power to conquer the universe.Unfortunately for Dagon, he wasn't the Devil in the Deal. Devour the Dragon:SomewhatInverted. Kills and absorbsDagonto take hisgodlike power for himself, but Vilgax technically wasThe Dragonin the whole thing. However, Dagon was hisUnwitting Pawnthe entire time, so it may have beenPlayed Straight. Did You Just Scam Cthulhu?:He successfully manipulated Dagon by faking submission, letting him kill George and eventually uses a machine brought by Psyphon to absorb him, gaining his powers. The Dragon: He acts like this forDagonin Season 2,but of course, knowing him, in the end he ends up betraying him and absorbing him to obtain his power, becoming theTrue Final Boss.

characters.name: Enoch
characters.description: The first Forever Knight leader to be introduced in the Original Series, serving under Driscoll. All for Nothing: He was anArch-Enemyto Max Tennyson in trying to find the Sword of Ek Chuaj in "The Ultimate Weapon", and after playing his cards right, he gets to be the one to draw the sword first... only for it to turn to dust in his very hand, as the blade was so ancient that it basically fell apart from the strain of being moved around. Enoch is in such a silentVillainous Breakdown, he can't help but cradle the dust trying to getsomethingout of it even as the Mayan temple collapses around him. How he survived is unknown. The Cameo: His picture made a brief appearance in aThe Secret Saturdaysepisode. Expressive Mask: Averted in the Original Series. Played straight during his short cameo inUltimate Alien. The Faceless: We never got to see what he looks like behind his mask.

characters.name: The Squires
characters.description: A group of robot infiltrators posing as a Little League baseball team, with the true goal of abducting the President when he comes to watch a game Improbable Weapon User: The player robots throw baseballs hard enough to blow holes through metal walls and baseball bats hard enough to embed them halfway into concrete. Kill and Replace: Their plan for Cash and JT when they're caught snooping around, and ultimately for the President. King Mook: The coach robot is noticeably larger and better armed than the common player robots. Mecha-Mooks: Once their infiltration plan is revealed, they resort to brute force to try and accomplish their goals, only to be mowed down as easily as any of Ben's other mechanical foes.

characters.name: Sir / Forever King Driscoll
characters.description: The Forever King of the Forever Knights faction met in the original series, who serves as theBig Badof season 4. Bad Boss: Abandoned Enoch in aLotus-Eater Machinefor failing him too many times. Bald of Evil: Very hairless and very villainous. Big Bad: He serves as the main antagonist of Season 4 in the original series. The Bus Came Back: While the Forever Knights have a presence in every series, Driscoll himself disappears during theAlien Forceera. He ends up making a return duringUltimate Alienwhen George unifies all the Forever Knight factions.

characters.name: Red Knight
characters.description: Actually a Doombot: Revealed to be a robot undernearth the armor. The Brute: Is there purely as muscle for Driscoll. Mook Carryover: It ended up in service to the last Forever King, who is currently Chadwick. Ninja Pirate Robot Zombie: A robotic ninja masquerading as a knight.

characters.name: Forever King Patrick
characters.description: The leader of a Forever Knight faction trying to slay a dragon. Said dragon actually was an alien mapmaker who had been mistaken for a threat by the Knights and kept trapped for 1,000 years. After the Dragon was sent back home by Ben, he and his faction decide to keep watching in case the dragons come back for revenge. Aborted Arc: His faction's plan to find and invade the Dragon's homeworld never got a conclusion, and was completely dropped when Old George came back to unite the factions. Beard of Evil: He sports a long and pointy goatee. Benevolent Boss: He supports his men morally, and takes failure much better than Driscoll does. Evil Old Folks: Though notthatevil, he still is the oldest Forever King to date after Sir George.

characters.name: Connor
characters.description: The Ace: Stated to be the greatest Forever Knight, which is why he was given the duty of killing the dragon. BFG: Connor is granted the right to wield the Quantum Disassembler Cannon, which seems to be a really big fancy laser cannon. Connor is tasked with using it to kill the dragon. Desperately Looking for a Purpose in Life: Once the dragon escapes, Connor feels his entire life up until now has been utterly pointless and he no longer has a purpose. Patrick however restores his faith by stating there is a whole planet of dragons out there and any of them could return for revenge at any point. The Dragon: He is Patrick's second-in-command and is hailed as the greatest Forever Knight under Patrick's command. Eyepatch of Power: He sports one during his return inUltimate Alien.

characters.name: Squire
characters.description: The Apprentice: He's still a squire in training, meaning he assists the knights that rank higher than him. Dirty Coward: He tries to play brave, but as soon as a gigantic Humungousaur presses him against the wall, he spills all the beans whilst talking at rapid speed. Mr. Exposition: He provides a lot of the Forever Knights' history for both the heroes and the audience. No Name Given: His real name is never revealed, with him only ever being referred to as "Squire". Suspiciously Similar Substitute: Received one inUltimate Alien, in the form of Winston.

characters.name: Dr./King Joseph Chadwick
characters.description: A scientist from King Patrick's faction that tried to kidnap Ship in an attempt to create a spaceship capable of going after the Dragon homeworld. He becomes the leader of the remaining Forever Knights inOmniverse. Applied Phlebotinum: Uses a formula created byDr. Jekyll(who was a Forever Knight) using alien DNA to mutate himself into a gorilla-like monster. Beard of Evil: He has grown a sinister goatee byOmniverse. Deadpan Snarker: This is a Tim Curry role what else did you expect? Emperor Scientist: ByOmniversehe has become the new king of his faction of the Forever Knights, but is still aMad Scientistwho harnesses experimental technology and serums.

characters.name: Sir Morton
characters.description: Dr. Chadwick'schief enforcerand one of the Forever Knight remnants to survive intoOmniverse. Awesome Aussie:Kevin Michael Richardsongives him an Australian accent, and he's able to manhandle Kevin with ease. Badass Biker: InAlien Force, he was riding some kind of motorjet. The Dragon: He is Chadwick's main muscle. After Chadwick ascends to Forever King, this makes Morton the new second-in-command of the entire Forever Knight remnant. Dumb Muscle: InOmniverse, he is depicted more as brawn with his common sense toned down. He's however still intelligent enough to know when to disobey Chadwick.

characters.name: Foreverbot
characters.description: Death by Falling Over: How it's dealt with. Especially humiliating for the Forever Knight's weapon of vengeance. Fake Ultimate Mook: It's a hulking robot that can look Humungosaur in the eye, but ultimately it's hampered by its lack of weaponry besides its fists, sub-par durability and its own shoddy artificial intelligence. Irony: In the comic it appears, Ben's artificially inflated intelligence via Brainstorm is grating on Kevin, and ultimately it'sKevin'sintelligence (and the Foreverbot's lack thereof) that sees it defeated. For bonus points, despite his smarts Ben tries to take it on in a straightforward fight instead of outthinking it.

characters.name: Sir George
characters.description: An enigmatic, immortal knight who is responsible for creating the Forever Knights in the Middle Ages. After being absent for centuries, George eventually comes back inUltimate Aliento re-unite his order and ready them to fight an incoming threat, theEldritch AbominationDagon. Though well-intentioned and extremely moral, George believes all aliens are monsters, and wants them banished from Earth or dead. Adapted Out: Unlike most tellings of St. George and The Dragon, there's no mention of a princess being involved whom he had to rescue. Affably Evil: Even when opposed to Ben and his team, he acts polite and respectful towards them. When they fight together against Dagon and Ben is seemingly killed, George actually states he will ensure his death will be avenged. Arch-Enemy: To Dagon. Having been responsible for sealing Dagon away centuries ago and dedicated his existence to preventing Dagon's return. Beethoven Was an Alien Spy: He is the same person the taleSaint George and the Dragonspeaks of.

characters.name: Sir / Forever King Urien
characters.description: The leader of another separate Forever Knight faction. Bad Boss: HisEstablishing Character Momenthas him electrocute one of his knights as a punishment for failure. Flat Character: Has no characterization outside of being "just another Forever King". Powered Armor: His classic armor gives him enhanced strength and the ability to shoot electrical blasts. In "Duped", he shortly acquires a new, mecha-like alien armor. Shout-Out: ToKing Arthur's brother-in-law of the same name in some versions ofArthurian Legend.

characters.name: Sir Cyrus
characters.description: The leader of a Forever Knight faction who proclaims to follow the path of "the First Knight". Co-Dragons: After Sir. George returns, he serves this role along with Driscoll. Fantastic Racism: Chides his squire Winston for flirting with the non-human (entirely) Gwen. Minor Major Character: He's a leader of a Forever Knight faction, being the equivalent of a Forever King, but doesn't really stand out with any individual characterization due to never debuting as an independent threat to Ben. Motive Decay: Inverted, as his faction carries on George's goal of battling the Dragon.

characters.name: Sir Dagonet
characters.description: No-Nonsense Nemesis: A particularly ruthless Forever Knight who manages to capture Ben's team and came very close to executing their alien captive Andreas. Villain Teleportation: He tries to take out the heroes by setting off his cannon's self-destruct mechanism while teleporting his knights away before it blows.

characters.name: foreverduke 838
characters.description: 24-Hour Armor: He wears his armor and helm even while he games. Disconnected by Death: He is killed mid-call with Jimmy after the castle is attacked by Andreas. Online Alias: He is only known by his gamer handle of "foreverduke838" with his real name being unknown.

characters.name: The Black Knight
characters.description: Absurdly Sharp Blade: He wields a physical sword of sotoraggian make, which is high quality enough for Kevin to comment on. Ambiguous Situation:He offers Ben and his allies a chance to surrender and leave peacefully, and asks them not to force his hand with violence. On the surface these seem likeNoble Demontraits but Kevin calls it out as an attempt to avoid a fight out of fear. It's never explicitly stated whether he's right or not.When unmasked, Enoch claims he's fallen far and his actions as the Black Knight are his last-ditch attempt to regain his honor and standing. But his last appearance inUltimate Alien(which aired before the comic's release) has him as one of the Forever Kings. What happened between then and the comic to cause him to fall so far is never explained, nor is whether he regained his old station by the time of his demise fighting the Esoterica and Dagon. He offers Ben and his allies a chance to surrender and leave peacefully, and asks them not to force his hand with violence. On the surface these seem likeNoble Demontraits but Kevin calls it out as an attempt to avoid a fight out of fear. It's never explicitly stated whether he's right or not. When unmasked, Enoch claims he's fallen far and his actions as the Black Knight are his last-ditch attempt to regain his honor and standing. But his last appearance inUltimate Alien(which aired before the comic's release) has him as one of the Forever Kings. What happened between then and the comic to cause him to fall so far is never explained, nor is whether he regained his old station by the time of his demise fighting the Esoterica and Dagon. Armor-Piercing Question: Ben hits him with two after his defeat. The first is to rhetorically ask whether the Forever Knights could stand to lose a pathetic loose end like him. The second is to ask why of the two of them,only Ben seems to have grown up since they first started fighting each other five years ago.

characters.name: Comedy and Tragedy
characters.description: Ambiguously Human: It's not clear if they're human or robots like the Red Knight. The Dividual: Never seen without each other and their motif only works with the two of them together. The Voiceless: They never speak in any of their appearances.

characters.name: The Highbreed
characters.description: A species ofScary Dogmatic Alienswho attempt to invade Earth in season 1 and 2 ofBen 10: Alien Force. Highbreed believe themselves to be the first, and therefore genetically purest, species in the Universe, and that all other living beings are inferiors that need to be exterminated like vermin. While powerful on their own, they are unwilling to have direct contact with other species, and instead use genetically engineeredMooks, theDNAliens, to do their dirty work. Absolute Xenophobe: All that matters is them; everyone else is vermin. All There in the Manual: According to merchandise and videogames, "Highbreed" is not their actual/original species name; it's "Atasian". All Your Powers Combined:After Ben recalibrates their genetic makeup, this is what happens. Always Chaotic Evil:Subverted; the only reason they are evil is because of their xenophobic, racist ideology. Reinrassic III gradually becomes nicer following hisEnemy Minewith Ben, and, after he convinced his comrades to give up the wholeOmnicidal Maniacway, they are no longer portrayed as evil.

characters.name: TheDNAliens
characters.description: The Highbreeds'Mooks, created from other species by way of an alien parasite called a "Xenocite". Aliens Among Us:DNAlienswear holographic ID masks in order to appear as normal humans, in many cases implied to be their human identities before they were converted. This means that potentially anyone that the team encounters could be aDNAlienin disguise. Assimilation Plot: The subjects of it. Body Horror: In "Max Out", they thankfully skip over what happens, but it spells out with Ken Tennyson that theDNAliensare one giganticAssimilation Plot, transforming ordinary human people into alien creatures and overwriting them atthe genetic level. Judging by apartially-converted Ken, it's a painful and mentally traumatizing event. Brainwashed and Crazy: Xenocites compel their host to be zealously loyal to the Highbreed. However, as an extra measure, it's impliedDNAliensare also subject to reconditioning to ensure their obedience.

characters.name: Attea
characters.description: All Amazons Want Hercules: She's infatuated with Ben's Bullfrag form, a strong, muscular, and handsome Incursean who managed to defeat her in combat. Though she's most attracted to Bullfrag, she's also at least partially interested in Ben himself as the galaxy's most powerful hero. Alpha Bitch: Sort of. She only acts like this towards Ben, but to every other character, she has no ill will. Arch-Enemy: By Omniverse, Attea has held quite a personal grudge against Ben for thwarting her plans to overthrow her father and having her put in stasis jail. Ben doesn't quite reciprocate at first, but Attea's importance in hisRogues Gallerygradually ascends as she proves herself to be more of a threat. Both later come to see each other asWorthy Opponentsby the end of the arc. Ascended Extra: She was a one-shot character inAlien Force, but becomesThe HeavyofOmniverse's third arc. Ax-Crazy: Remember when she tried to destroy EarthFor the Evulzas a child? Unlike Kevin, aging doesn't make her less hostile.

characters.name: Milleous
characters.description: "Lord Emperor Milleous, light of the Incursean Empire, destroyer of galaxies, keeper of the conquest ray, all beings tremble...". Milleous is the Emperor of the Incursean Empire, anAx-Crazywarlord who conquers planets for a living. Abusive Parents: Milleous isn't a very kind father to Attea. It's suggested that he put his wife in a stasis pod and threatened to actually eliminate Attea forfailing him several times. Acrofatic: Milleous is fat, but he still has frog-like agility and jumping ability. Adipose Rex: Compared to his scrawny minions and his fit daughter, Emperor Milleous is stocky and fat. This is likely due to his status as Emperor allowing him to eat all he likes compared to his malnourished troops with his more sedentary lifestyle causing him to grow fat.

characters.name: Raff
characters.description: Raff is a commander of the Incursean Armada. He is the right-hand man of Emperor Milleous and Princess Attea. Affably Evil: He is polite to the heroes despite serving his Incursean Warlords who would destroy them without hesitation. Beleaguered Assistant: His masters have a tendency to execute those who fail. He worries about securing a sector because Attea will yell at him again. My Brain Is Big: A trait that is consistent with his species is having a large visible brain underneath a metallic shell. One-Steve Limit: He is not to be confused with the similarly named Rath who is one of Ben's Omnitrix aliens.

characters.name: Michael Morningstar / Darkstar
characters.description: Alliterative Name:MichaelMorningstar. Ambiguously Human: Unlike most of the other Plumber's kids, who looked very alien, and are explicitly stated to beHalf Human Hybrids, Morningstar looks completely human, and it's never made clear whether he is part-alien or not. And I Must Scream: His fate at the hands of Charmcaster at the end of "Mystery, Incorporeal", magically trapped inside Charmcaster's bag with no way to escape. No one can hear him except Charmcaster and Addwaitya, who's also trapped. Arch-Enemy:To Gwen, being one of her most personal enemies, only eclipsed by the likes of Hex (who pulls aHeel–Face Turn) and Charmcaster (who develops into anAnti-Villain). HisVillainous Crushon her and her role in turning him into Darkstar makes their rivalry much more personal than with the other heroes.To Kevin. Darkstar has a particular strong hatred towards Kevin, due to him and Kevin having both competed for Gwen's affection, while Kevin was instrumental in seeing through his ruse and defeating him on several occasions. There's also the fact that their powers are very similar and he's often played up as Kevin'sEvil Counterpart, which often leads the two of them to have personal scenes together. To Gwen, being one of her most personal enemies, only eclipsed by the likes of Hex (who pulls aHeel–Face Turn) and Charmcaster (who develops into anAnti-Villain). HisVillainous Crushon her and her role in turning him into Darkstar makes their rivalry much more personal than with the other heroes.

characters.name: Albedo
characters.description: Azmuth's former assistant, and Ben'sEvil Twin. Originally a Galvan, Albedo asked his master for his own Omnitrix. When Azmuth refused, he created a copy of it and set it to match Ben's. However, since Ben's Omnitrix had Ben's DNA as the default form, it ended up turning Albedo into a clone of Ben with the same alien transformations, but unable to turn back to his original form. Since then, Albedo is obsessed with getting his hands on the Omnitrix so he can use it to turn back to normal. Aliens Love Human Food: Albedo finds himself craving chili fries upon taking on the form of a teenage human boy. However unlike his genetic template, Albedo's obsession with chili fries verges on addiction. Anti-Villain:Type II. Theonlyreason he ever became a villain in the first place was to get his original Galvan form back. When he temporarily gets it back inUltimate Alien, he was actually more than willing to give up revenge on Ben and leave Earth. InOmniverse, however, he devolves into a pure villain. Arch-Enemy:To Azmuth, blaming him for trapping him in the form of a human and exacting revenge for this reason.To Ben. Ever since Ben foiled his plans, he has been constantly after revenge on the hero. He even has an arc inOmniverseof him seeking revenge. To Azmuth, blaming him for trapping him in the form of a human and exacting revenge for this reason.

characters.name: Psyphon
characters.description: Vilgax's assistant and lackey, introduced in season 3 ofBen 10: Alien Force(before this, Vilgax couldn't find anyone willing to join him on a regular basis and was limited to using robots). Few things are known about Psyphon. He is a skilled scientist in charge with most of Vilgax's technology. For unknown reasons, Psyphon is deeply loyal to Vilgax. Avenging the Villain: Attempts this on Ben to avenge Vilgax's apparent death. He fails. Battle Butler: Vilgax's lackey, and while he doesn't fight that often, "Reflected Glory" shows he is quite capable of kicking ass. The Dragon: He is Vilgax's most trusted servant and 100% loyal to his master. Evil Genius: He appears to be an brilliant scientist and often is the one building devices for Vilgax.

characters.name: The Vreedle Family
characters.description: Artificial Human: Well Artificial Alien in this case, but they were still created in a lab. Ascended Extra: While the Vreedles were already quite frequent appearing characters, after their debut they were scarcely the main focus of the episode.Omniversededicates several episodes to exploring their entire family. Batman Can Breathe in Space: Vreedles all appear to have the ability to survive the vacuum of space. The Family That Slays Together: The entire family are criminal, with different members displaying varying degrees of love for each other. Family Theme Naming: All of their children are named after geometric shapes.

characters.name: The Techadons
characters.description: A series of very powerful, mass-produced robots that are sold as war machines by a mysterious organization known as the Weaponmasters of Techadon, which Inspector 13 is a member of. Adaptive Ability: Destroy one, and the factory will then produce another one immune to that method of destruction. Rinse, repeat. The Assimilator: If a Techadon is destroyed but part of him (typically his hand) survives, it can then take over a host to rebuild itself over his body, gradually turning him into a Techadon. Cash almost ended up with this fate. Conservation of Ninjutsu: When faced one at a time, they were typically formidable opponents. On the occasion that several were fought at once, they went down like flies. The Determinator: Once they have been set on a target, they won't stop until said target is dead. Not even the one who hired them can cancel the order.

characters.name: Simian
characters.description: An Arachnichimp met duringAlien Force. Simian initially introduced himself as a prince from Arachscimia intending to pass a test consisting in getting a precious crystal to become king. It later turned out he was lying: he was actually aCon Manhired by Highbreed to steal said crystal, which was a power source for a Plumber station on the Moon. Ben was able to prevent him from leaving with the crystal, though, leading him to aYou Have Failed Mesituation with his hirer. He later turns out to have survived and returns to help. And I Must Scream: He gets turned into a card by Collectimus. Asshole Victim: Non-lethal version; while he ended up surviving both times, two episodes featuring him end with him stuck in a less-than-pleasant situation (one where it seems like he wasintendedto die before the writers changed her mind), and considering how unsympathetic he is, we probably aren't mean to sympathize. The Bad Guy Wins: He gets off pretty good in his second appearance, where he saves his species, he gets into the good graces of the heroes, and he's pinched their valuable guns and sold them off for a fetching profit. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: In his first appearance, he appears to be a pretty nice guy until his act is revealed in the last minutes of the episode.

characters.name: The Hive
characters.description: The villains from the second live-action movie "Alien Swarm". The Hive is an army of living, techno-organic, bug-like nanochips with the ability to both infest people in order to take over their minds and fuse together to form various structures. They were discovered by Plumber's member Victor Validus, but the others refused to believe him, and they ended up taking over him. Eventually, the Swarm was stopped when Ben used the sample of their own species, Nanomech, to reach the Queen inside Validus' brain and apparently kill her. They eventually return inUltimate Alien, where it's revealed that the Hive Queen killed by Ben was actually a decoy, while the real one hid inside Validus' daughter (and Ben's childhood friend) Elena. Eventually, Elena's personality fused with the Hive's mind, causing her to become crazy and turn into anAx-CrazyYandere. Ambiguous Situation: With the retcon inUltimate Alienthat the Queen featured inAlien Swarmwas a decoy with Elena being the true Queen, it becomes less clear on who it was that was controlling the drones. Interestingly, in the film they were hellbent on infecting everyone in the world, while inUltimate Alien, Elena is not interested in assimilation and only desires to make Ben hers. The Assimilator: Their MO is to infect and take over everyone on the entire planet. Big Bad: Of the second live-action movie, specifically the Queen.

characters.name: Ssserpent
characters.description: A snake-like alien.Not really that much of a threat. Acid Attack: He can spit acid strong enough to melt metal. Ascended Extra: He gets a much bigger role in the comics compared to the show. Bit-Part Bad Guys: With the exception of "The Perfect Girlfriend" (where he is still not the main villain but is at least allowed to be somewhat competent), all his appearances consist of him showing up at the start of an episode and promptly getting his ass kicked by Ben, often in a comedic fashion. Butt-Monkey: His first two appearances have him being defeated hilariously easy by Ben.

characters.name: Sunder the Retriever
characters.description: ABounty Hunterintroduced inAlien Force. Like many others before him, Sunder is usually seen intending to get Ben's Omnitrix. Bounty Hunter: He was hired by someone to get the Omnitrix from Ben inAlien Forceepisode "Singlehanded", and in his re-appearance in "The Transmogrification of Eunice", it's revealed he was hired by Azmuth to take the Unitrix back. Expy: He is actually a mixture of twoMarvelvillains:He rides something similar tothe Goblin Glider. What form did Ben take when they first fought? Spidermonkey.In overall appearance, he's more blatantly a reference to Terrax the Tamer, a herald of Galactus and enemy of theFantastic Four. He rides something similar tothe Goblin Glider. What form did Ben take when they first fought? Spidermonkey. In overall appearance, he's more blatantly a reference to Terrax the Tamer, a herald of Galactus and enemy of theFantastic Four.

characters.name: Red and Blue Leaders
characters.description: The respective Generals of a planet caught in eternal civil war, with them warring over the silliest of reasons… the color of the statue of their Leader. Con Artist: The real reason they are warring, is so that they now have the war to blame for all their political problems rather than fixing this themselves. Enemy Civil War: A bizarre case where they are the enemies of Benbecauseof their own civil war. Enemy Mine:After Ben captures the two of them and forces them to negotiate a peace deal, they briefly team up by devising a plan to incapacitate Ben and escape.After Way Big accidentally destroys the statue of their Leader, both Red and Blue armies combine into the Purple Army and declare Ben their new combined enemy. After Ben captures the two of them and forces them to negotiate a peace deal, they briefly team up by devising a plan to incapacitate Ben and escape.

characters.name: Ragnarok
characters.description: An alien criminal who makes profit off draining stars of their energy to sell to other planets, which would result in all lives in said star system to perish in the process. Ragnarok is an especially personal enemy to Kevin, due to allegedly being responsible for the death of Kevin's father Devin. Ambiguous Situation: After theOmniverseretcon thatDevin Levin never existed and that Ragnarok was part of the Rooters conspiracy, it becomes unclear just what exactly he did do to make Max trap him in the Null Void. Arch-Enemy: To Kevin for the one episode he was in. Asshole Victim: Not only did he kill Devinat least until the event of him killing Devin is revealed to have been fake inOmniverse, he was also planning to destroy the stars of galaxies and kill millions of people for profit, which made him absolutely deserve his horrible death. Evil Sounds Deep: His deep voice, coupled with him beingThe Stoic, only make him more imposing.

characters.name: Jarett
characters.description: An obese, cruel tyrant who rules the Phantophage. He bullies weaker species and civilizations into giving up their crown princes for him to eat. Adipose Rex: He's the king of the Phantopage and given his width he clearly eats like a king. Affably Evil: He genuinely thanks the trio for delivering the Tiffen to him and for their troubles, and was still friendly to the trio even if he was being smug after eating it. Big Bad Wannabe:Played Within that he and his army are a genuine threat to other civilizations that run afoul of him, but ultimately he's proven to be a cowardly bully who gets easily cowed by Rath. His standing in the galaxy also takes a hit by the time ofOmniverseas Tiffen eating gets outlawed thanks to public knowledge about his habits. The Bully: He forces weaker civilizations to give him peace offerings under threat of war otherwise. It takes a bigger bully, Rath, to bring him down.

characters.name: Aggregor
characters.description: All Your Powers Combined: the first step in his plan is to permanently assimilateFire, Water, Earth, Wind, and Electricpowers from a quintet of aliens from the Andromeda Galaxy. Anti-Magic: Courtesy of absorbing Galapagus. Artificial Human:He's confirmed byWord of Godto be an artificial human with Kevin's DNA created by the Rooters in the past. Badass Longcoat: With no shirt, underneath. Big Bad: of Season 1 ofUltimate Alienuntil he ends up being defeated and replaced byUltimate Kevin.

characters.name: Dagon
characters.description: Adaptational Abomination: Dagon is revealed to be the identity of the dragon that Saint George fought. Unlike in the original legend, the dragon is merely one form of a Cthulhu-likeMultiversal Conquerorwhose mere visage is unpleasant to look at. Adaptational Badass: In the original tale of St. George & The Dragon, he was slain by George, but here, even getting his heart cut out didn't kill him. In addition, he has the ability tomind controlpeople. And Show It to You: Old George tore out his heart. This didn't kill him and he had to be turned intoSealed Evil in a Can. Arch-Enemy: To Sir George. Big Bad: of Season 2 ofUltimate Alienuntil he ends up being betrayed and absorbed byVilgax.

characters.name: Conduit Edward
characters.description: The leader of the Esoterica cult. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: Initially introduced as a very nice, polite, well-intentioned businessman. Later revealed as a fanatic cult leader who has no problem threatening to trap Julie between two dimensions to get Ben to obey him. Corrupt Corporate Executive: Played with; he isn't seen doing anything technically criminal, but he is a wealthy businessman, and hedoeslead an evil cult trying to bring back anEldritch Abominationin our world. The Dragon: To Dagon. Dying Curse:To George, after getting impaled on Ascalon.Edward:May Dagon curse you.

characters.name: Will Harangue
characters.description: An anchorman who for unknown reasons developed a violent hatred of aliens after Ben's existence was revealed to the world inUltimate Alien. Harangue is convinced that aliens are a menace (especially Ben), and passes most of his time trying to convince everyone that he is right. Occasionally, he will also attempt things against Ben himself, but most of his appearances only have him criticizing Ben on TV. Asshole Victim: It's hard to feel bad for him now that he has beentransformed into an alien himself. Attention Whore: Implied with his numerous berating reports, where he does those for him to obtain higher viewer ratings as a news reporter. Became Their Own Antithesis: He wants to get rid of aliens from planet Earth, but in the end, everyone else has been alienating him after they found out about his true nature when hesupported the Incurseans, further emphasized byhis transformation as a literal alien. Blatant Lies: He tried to save his reputation after the Incursean Invasion by pretending he was acting undercover to save Earth and was prevented from doing it by Ben. Nobody buys it. Not evenChadwick.

characters.name: Addwaitya
characters.description: A villain introduced in "Where the Magic Happens", and theBig Badfrom Charmcaster's perspective. A Geochelone Aerio magic-user, Addwaitya was once a revered philosopher amongst his people, until he somehow ended up in the possession of the Alpha Rune, an artifact that granted him control over Magic itself. He used it to take over the dimension of Ledgerdomain, exterminating the civilization of human spellcasters who had been living here and enslaving the others. Hex and Charmcaster were the only known survivors thanks to the sacrifice of Charmcaster's father, Spellbinder. Above Good and Evil: What he, and any possessor of the Alpha Rune, perceive themselves as due to theirpractical godhood. He doesn't care about helping or harming the universe, just about maintaining a tight grip on his dimension. And I Must Scream:Charmcaster puts him in this situation after she overthrew him...twice, in fact, through two different methods. The second method ends up a subversion, as he's mostly kept in her magic bag where he is free to move around like normal. Arch-Enemy: To Charmcaster. Asshole Victim:Probably the only one of Charmcaster's victims that no one will miss. Though his life was returned to him afterwards.

characters.name: Morgg
characters.description: A corrupt warden who uses the Incarcecon in the Null Void as a drug operation. He's responsible for the death of Kevin's old mentor, hence why he's targeted by Ultimate Kevin. Asshole Victim: Not quite, but very nearly by Ultimate Kevin. Given that Morgg uses his job as a warden just for drug trafficking and using prisoners as slaves, he certainly had it coming. Dirty Coward: He used a device that activated sonic collars on prisoners, but became completely defenseless after it got destroyed. From Bad to Worse: He was nothing more than an amoral guard. Now he's acorrupt wardenwho uses the prisoners as slaves to mine a valuable resource he can sell as a drug. Hate Sink: Morgg is anincredibly amoral wardenwith absolutely no redeeming qualities. Not only did he kill Kwarrel, but he also treats prisoners as slaves and forces them to mine a resource he can sell as a drug.

characters.name: Captain Nemesis
characters.description: Accidental Misnaming: Nemesis thinks Ben's name is "Tim Bennyson". Arguably, this is thefirst sign that he's not the hero that everyone thinks he is. Actor Allusion: This is not the only time ChristopherMcDonaldplayeda formerly esteemed hero-turned-supervillain wannabein his career. Ambiguously Evil: When asked by a fan if Captain Nemesis is a sociopath, DwayneMcDuffiestates that he wasn't innocent, implying that Captain Nemesis alwaysdidhave narcissistic, fame-seeking tendencies deep down (or prone to) even if he was genuine in wanting to help others at the start. Obviously, after years of being a famousInvincible Hero, whatever sort of altruism that Nesmith does have is overshadowed by his ego and fame-seeking. Arch-Enemy: Despite Vilgax taking the spot as Ben's arch-enemy, Captain Nemesis also serves as this for Ben due to him being his childhood hero. Astonishingly Appropriate Appearance: HisPowered Armordoesn't cover up his face, not even with a lens. Also, he's never seen taking the armor off his body. This shows just how much of anAttention WhoreCaptain Nemesis is.

characters.name: Trombipulor
characters.description: Aardvark Trunks: An inversion; while he has a normal-looking trunk inUltimate Alien, inOmniversehis mouth is located at end of his trunk. Ascended Extra: InUltimate Alien, he was just aBit Part Bad Guywho showed up a couple of times and did very little. His firstOmniverseappearance gives him a whole episode. Bit-Part Bad Guys: Was introduced as this inUltimate Alien. Cruel Elephant: Well, he's elephantlikeand certainly isn't pleasant. Curb-Stomp Battle: In "Universe vs. Tennyson", Way Big defeats him by literally stepping on him.

characters.name: Inspector  13
characters.description: Formerly one of the Weapon Masters of Techadon. In theUltimate Alienepisode of the same name, he attempted to steal the Ultimatrix from Ben. InOmniverse, it is revealed that he was removed from the Techadon Empire for his failure to capture the Ultimatrix, and has become an independent businessman. Arms Dealer: After being disgraced, he puts his skills to use selling weapons to other villains. Badass Bookworm: A technological genius who knows how to use his arsenal for offensive and defensive purposes. Badass Normal: Has become this by his second appearance. While he has no powers or superior physical attributes. He is still able to fight evenly against the genuinely superpowered Albedo, using only his arsenal of technology and his wits. Crazy-Prepared: Seems to have weapons and defenses to deal witheverysituation.

characters.name: Prisoner  775
characters.description: A Merlinisapien who was once the leader of a revolution against a tyrannical and oppressive government, he was captured and exiled from his homeworld. He arrived on Earth seeking refuge and aid, but in spite of his pleas, Colonel Rozum imprisoned him in Area 51. Prisoner 775 spent 50 years imprisoned, during which time the revolution was destroyed and his family killed. The traumatic loss and his imprisonment left him a vengeful and unhinged wreck who will do anything it takes to get revenge on Rozum. Aliens of London: He speaks with a German accent that, at times, sounds very close to the one Baker uses when voicingKlaus Heisler. Anti-Villain: During his rampage on the town, he spares a police officer after learning he has a family and generally does his best to avoid hurting innocents... unless they happen to beColonel Rozum's family. Chameleon Camouflage: He can change color to blend in with his environment. Death Seeker: When Ultimate Wildmutt corners him, he demands and then pleads for Ben to do the deed.Prisoner 775:Do it! Finish me! Come on! Let me join my family! Do it!Do it![Ultimate Wildmutt transforms back into Ben while he slides off the back of the car he was pinned against]Pleasedo it! Please... finish me... I've got nothing...

characters.name: Mizaru
characters.description: Dropped a Bridge on Him: Shortly after swearing his revenge, he is abruptly eaten by a Root Shark. Fat Bastard: Compared to Spidermonkey, he's much more broad and round, looking more like an ape, and is far from pleasant. King Mook: After being bound to a Xenocyte Queen, he uses his newfound power to convert the entire Arachnochimp species into hisDNAlienslaves. Maniac Monkeys: A rogue Arachnachimp who is the ruler of his home planet, using Xenocytes to enslave his people, in order to kill Ben. Meaningful Name: He is named after one of the Three Wise Monkeys, specifically the "See No Evil" monkey. When he's taken over by the Xenocite Queen, his eyes are covered up.

characters.name: Malware
characters.description: Malware is a psychotic Galvanic Mechomorph who serves as the villain of the flashbacks in Season 1, as well as theBig Badof Season 2 inOmniverse. He was an incomplete Galvanic Mechamorph created accidentally by Azmuth during the development of Galvan B by shutting down the Helix (the device that created the original Galvanic Mechamorphs) right while he was being produced. As a result, Malware was born corrupted, with the ability to absorb technology and gain its ability instead of upgrading it. Azmuth spent years developing a new Helix in order to cure him, but Malware eventually lost patience and stole it from him, using it to upgrade himself into a form that apparently eliminated his need for energy while retaining his old abilities. After that, he vowed to absorb the Omnitrix in order to gain its abilities. After destroying Ben's Feedback form, he was seemingly killed when Ben overloaded him with the Omnitrix.Somehow, he survived and returned to menace Ben years later. Aborted Arc:The end of "Malgax Attacks" hinted that turning him into a suit for Vilgax may have brought him back to life, but this was the last time he made any sort of appearance before the series ended. Had the series continued after arc 8, he would have been featured as a potential member of the new Negative 10. Anti-Villain: He started out as a very twistedType II. However, once he got upgraded, he became a straight villain. Arch-Enemy: While only appearing in one series Malware's many battles with 11 and 16 year old Ben and the level of terror, dread, and disdain between the two gives Malware a claim to the title.Killing Feedback, more or less, for half a decade is a very personal blow and Malware is one of a very few number of villains who Ben has shown to be afraid of. He notably retains an air of dread and fear around him that makes him stand out inOmniversecompared to many others. Arm Cannon:His right hand became one after he absorbed the Tachyon Cannon.

characters.name: Dr. Psychobos
characters.description: A Cerebrocrustacean (Brainstorm's species) scientist who is responsible for the creation of Khyber's Nemetrix. Dr. Psychobos has a strong hatred of the Galvan species as a whole, and especially Azmuth, who he has a personal rivalry with (though Azmuth apparently doesn't care). In an attempt to prove his species are the smartest in the universe,he teamed up with Malware in order to get the Omnitrix blueprints, so he could then use it to create his own, superior version of the Omnitrix. This resulted in the Nemetrix, a feral version of the device that could only work on creatures of limited intelligence. He and Malware then proceeded to hire Khyber to collect the DNA required to make it work. Always Second Best: Based on what Maltruant said, Dr. Psychobosisthe second smartest being in the Universe right behind Azmuth. Badass Bookworm: He is apparently the second smartest scientist in the Ben 10 Universe and has shown a few times he is quite capable of defending himself. Bad Boss: Along with Malware,he threatens Khyber on occasion. The next time he did this in "Showdown" to the point of attempting toMind Rapehim when Khyber refuses to obey.This bit him in the arse when Khyber decided to just leave him be whenAzmuth showed Psychobos' natural predator.To be fair though, he was on the other end of this trope with Malware To be fair though, he was on the other end of this trope with Malware

characters.name: Khyber the Huntsman
characters.description: An alienEgomaniac Hunter, who serves as theArc Villainof Season 1 inOmniverse, but was reallyThe Dragonto Malware, theGreater-Scope Villain. Khyber is accompanied by an alien dog-like creature known as an Anubian Baskurr which he equips with the "Nemetrix", a device similar to the Omnitrix that allows his pet to turn into various predatory species. He went to Earth following rumors about Ben's heroic acts and sees the boy as a worthy prey to add to his trophies. Affably Evil: He is quiet and polite in addition to having a sense of honor. However, he will not hesitate to add your head to his trophy collection if you're his prey. An Alien Named "Bob": Downplayed. He is a Zaroffian from the planet Sangerosia, who is named "Khyber", which is Hebrew for "fort" or "palace". Despite being exotic, it's still a human name. Arc Villain: Of A New Beginning Arc, being part of theBig Bad DuumvirateandThe Heavythat primarily menaces Ben. He later returns again partnered with Albedo. Awesome Aussie: He has a thick Australian accent to go along with his hunting persona.

characters.name: Nemetrix Aliens
characters.description: Beat Them at Their Own Game: Hypnotick could also turn intangible, Omnivoracious can outsmart Galvans, and Tyrannopede can out-strength Humongosaur.

characters.name: The Rooters
characters.description: The secret Black Ops branch of the Null Void Plumbers who went rogue. Artificial Hybrid:They all are former humanswho gained alien characteristics fromexperimenting on Kevin when he was in the Null Void.Proctor Servantis: Human/Cerebrocrustacean (Brainstorm's species)Agent Swift: Human/Aerophibian (Jetray's species)Magister Leander: Human/Prypiatosian-B (NRG's species)Phil Billings: Human/Terroranchula Proctor Servantis: Human/Cerebrocrustacean (Brainstorm's species) Agent Swift: Human/Aerophibian (Jetray's species) Magister Leander: Human/Prypiatosian-B (NRG's species)

characters.name: Evil Alternate Bens
characters.description: Alternate Bens that Vilgax and Eon worked to corrupt to have their own army of Omnitrix-wielders. All There in the Script: Almost all of them, sans Eon, Albedo and Mad Ben, are unnamed in the show, but can be found online. Elite Mooks: Ultimately their purpose is to serve as Vilgax and Eon's muscle. Evil Doppelgänger: Due to all of them being evil versions of Ben Tennyson, with Bad Ben having most of it. Amusingly, Albedo is among them as well. Fallen Hero: What some of them are bound to be, due to Vilgax and Eon corrupting them. Eon himself is also an alternate Ben.

characters.name: Maltruant
characters.description: And I Must Scream:After being scattered through time and space, Maltruant is forced to go back in time, start up hisEvil Plan, and relive his defeat over and over andoveragain. For all of eternity. And the worst part?He's not even aware of it, meaning that he'll never be able to break free. Arc Villain: of The Time War arc. Beam-O-War: He and Clockwork, who is enhanced by Ben 23's Upgrade, do this. Maltruant wins, disabling their Omnitrixes, proving just how powerful he is. Big "NO!": Screams this asFeedback blasts him with the Annihilargh's energy. Card-Carrying Villain: Going by his notion that Azmuth is "too smart to be evil", he's aware that villainy is dumb but doesn't care.

characters.name: Bubble Helmet
characters.description: One of Psyphon's three main henchmen, a worm-like being operating a suit of pressurized armor. Jack Bauer Interrogation Technique: Subjected to this when Ben vents the gaseous atmosphere in the bar he frequents, exposing him to Earth's air which he can't breathe. He manages to wriggle out of it by playing on Rook's inexperience.
