Weaksauce Weakness: Bubble Helmet's species can only breathe an atmosphere that's toxic on Earth; as a result, he needs his suit to be able to breathe on Earth.

characters.name: Fistina
characters.description: One of Psyphon's main three henchmen, a cyborg woman with rocket propelled fists. Abhorrent Admirer: Fistina is this towardRook. Brawn Hilda: Fistina; this is the kind of character that makes you think Looma isn't that ugly after all. Divergent Character Evolution: She, Bubble Helmet, and Liam start out as Psyphon's main goons without much character beyond that. She's the only one of the three to get individual character focus that eventually leads to herHeel–Face Turn. Expy: Fistina's design is based onCrasher.

characters.name: Liam
characters.description: One of Psyphon's main three henchmen, a chicken-like alien. He later becomes the genetic source for Ben's Kickin Hawk transformation. An Alien Named "Bob": Liam, who is an alien chicken with a pretty normal human name. Blade Below the Shoulder: He has a pair of spurs along his forearms that can be used as weapons. Nice Job Fixing It, Villain!: At the end of "Outbreak", Liam accidentally adds Kickin Hawk to Ben's repertoire by touching the Omnitrix. Odd Name Out: For a chicken-like alien, Liam is a pretty normal-sounding name. Which may or may not be aShout-OuttoRichard.

characters.name: Gorvan
characters.description: A short, out-of-shape Tetramand criminal who made hisfirst appearancein theAlien Forcevideo game. He's acameo characterin "Special Delivery"and later asThe Molein "Mud is Thicker Than Water". Acrofatic: Due to the nature of Tetramands, he's still quite fast despite his bulk. Adaptational Wimp: In theAlien Forcegame, he's able to hold his own against Ben, even using a machine to regularly heal himself. InOmniverse, he runs off once the Plumbers found Psyphon's hideout & is easily defeated by Gwen. Canon Immigrant: He initially was an original character in the video-game adaptation ofAlien Forcebefore actually having a role in the animation series. Fat Bastard: Unlike the rest of his species, Gorvan seems to be the only Tetramand that's overweight, and isn't a particularly nice person either.

characters.name: Fistrick
characters.description: A human crook with a rather personable attitude. Affably Evil: He's remarkably friendly for a crook, as he genuinely likes his gang instead of treating them like minions, and encourages healthy exercise and diets. He even casually greets Ben during "Bros in Space".Fistrick:What the...? Ben 10?[chuckles]That you bro? Badass Normal: He's human, yet he's able to hold his own against Shocksquatch, albeit with insulated boots. He still was remarkably easy to beat up for Kickin' Hawk, though.He's also strong enough to knock down a Tetramand with his bare fists. He's also strong enough to knock down a Tetramand with his bare fists. The Beastmaster: In "Bros In Space", he managed to turn Revonnah's Muriods into a formidable army, teaching them how to stand on two legs, operate machinery, and even taught them how to talk, though they could only say "Bro". Worth noting is that unlike Dr. Animo, he didn't use any machinery to do so.

characters.name: Billy Billions
characters.description: Alliterative Name:BillyBillions. Ambiguously Brown: He has a darker skintone compared to Ben, but an unknown ethnicity. There's also the fact that his voice actor is of Indo-Pakistani descent. Attention Whore: He is really desperate for attention to the point where he'll send Ben to Dimension 12 for being more popular than him. Big Bad Wannabe: He wants Ben to acknowledge him as hisArch-Enemyand destroyer. Ben barely acknowledges him as avillain, and in both the episodes Billy appears in, Ben claims thatanyof the Omnitrix aliens could beat Billy. Butt-Monkey: He apparently was somehow evenlesspopular than Ben at school (who in the Original Series was established to be pretty unpopular himself), his only attempt at getting rid of 10 years old Benresulted in him being trapped in another dimension without Ben even realizing he was being attacked, the trip there left him stuck in the body of a little kid, and on top of this, when he finallydoescome back to get his revenge, not only does he learn his hated rival has become a world-famous superhero, butBen doesn't remotely remember him.

characters.name: Mazuma
characters.description: Billy Billions' android bodyguard, assistant, and general minion. Bodyguard Babes: She's a gynoid built like a supermodel and wearing a cheerleader outfit serving as Billy's bodyguard (and according toWord of God, Billy designed her to look like his crush). Flat Character: She has a few moments of personality but most of her character is being Billy's yes-man and muscle. Fights Like a Normal: She has optic lasers and razor-sharp talons, but her preferred method of fighting is applying her mechanical speed and strength to martial arts. Terminator Impersonator: She has the classic 'layer of skin/false flesh over a mechanical endoframe' and her debut has her false face torn to reveal one mechanical eye.

characters.name: Princess Looma
characters.description: A female Tetramand Princess who Kevin met during the time between the original series and Alien Force. In an attempt to get a piece of technology from the Tetramands, Kevin agreed to become Looma's fiancé so he could get said piece as a wedding gift. This came back to bite him back when she arrived three years later to get married to him. In order to avoid it, Kevin pulled out aBatman Gambitthat led Ben to become Looma's fiancé instead of him. Abhorrent Admirer: Because of herviolent attitude, it's no wonder why Ben doesn't reciprocate her feelings at all. Affably Evil: Not so much toward Kevin, but she acts genuinely nice and sweet when interacting with Ben after they got betrothed.When she lost her engagement to him at the end of "Rules of Engagement", she genuinely seemed sorry about him and affectionately told him goodbye. All Amazons Want Hercules: She's an incredibly strongWarrior Princesspledged to any man who can defeat her in battle. Ben learned this the hard way. Anti-Villain: She's genuinely committed to her fiancés and an honorable warrior who respects aWorthy Opponent, but herRoyal Bratpersonality and her planet's dangerous customs still make her an antagonist.

characters.name: Nyancy Chan
characters.description: Nyancy Chan is a human female with the ability to hypnotize cats or cat-like creatures into doing her bidding. The Beastmaster: Cats only. Cat Girl: Well, she dresses as one, at least. Enemy Mine: With the other female characters in "The Most Dangerous Game Show". Flunky Boss: How dangerous is she depends on what kind of cats are under her control, she's pretty much harmless if no cats are around.

characters.name: Way Bads
characters.description: Mutated To'kustars created by Dr. Psychobos. They were used for the Incursean invasion but now inhabit the Null Void after being transported there. Always Chaotic Evil: As noted by Dr. Psychobos, they are nothing but feral creatures who destroy everything in their sight. The only way to restrain them is mind control. Beauty Equals Goodness: To contrast with the humanoid Way Big, whose species are calm and peaceful, the majority of them are highly monstrous and inhuman, making them feral and destructive. Cute Monster Girl: The most recurring one as seen on the image is depicted in a buxom figure and appears less grotesque than the others. Evil Counterpart: They as a whole are this to the original To'kustars, who are noted to beGentle Giantswhile the mutated ones are equivalent to rampaging beasts.

characters.name: Kundo
characters.description: A Revonnahgander fond of the old ways of his planet, and a master of Ravonnah Kai, their marital arts (which he taught to Rook Blonko before he left) A cantankerous elder, he particularly hates technology, outsiders, or those who have betrayed the old way of life. Arch-Enemy: He appears to have become this to Rook. Badass Normal: Before becoming a cyborg, he was able to fight Ben equally merely through his world's martial arts (Revonnaganders are pretty similar to humans in terms of base assets like strength or speed, making it even more notable) Boomerang Bigot: After being turned into a cyborg, he still sees technology as evil. He even woefully labels himself as a "walking contradiction". Broken Pedestal: Rook did not want to harm his former teacher until learning he had assaulted his father for letting Shar leave to become a Plumber. After that, the gloves are off.

characters.name: Subdora
characters.description: Subdora is a Merlinisapien (Chamalien's species), a minion of Maltruant and the girlfriend/accomplice of Exo-Skull. Aliens of London: She's an alien who speaks in a pseudo-Italian accent. Bilingual Bonus: Her name means "sneaky" in Italian. Classy Cat-Burglar: Shetriesto be, but Exo-Skull's method of brute force is usually more effective. Cute Monster Girl: Her figure is more humanoid than Chamlien or Prisoner 775's.

characters.name: Poltroon
characters.description: Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: He attends the peace negotiation with the Appoplexians, but it was actually a ploy for him to seize power over the Lewodans. Crazy-Prepared: He carried a device specifically to incapacitate Appoplexians, which he successfully uses on Rath. Evil Gloating: Taunts Ben for failing to live up to his reputation of Universe's Greatest Hero. Evil Sounds Deep: He has a very deep voice and is revealed to be villainous. Faux Affably Evil: Prior to his facade dropping, he seemed to be the polite voice of reason during the peace conference. This goes out the window once he reveals his true nature.

characters.name: OTTO
characters.description: A mechanical crime boss and thief. Affably Evil: He seems to be genuinely friendly towards Kevin, but it falls flat seeing as he ditched Kevin in the Null Void to escape on his own. Ambiguously Related: As much asA.I.scan be related anyways, but his holohead is very similar to Pyxi's, raising the possibility that they came from similar product lines. From Nobody to Nightmare: He started as an AI for an air conditioning system before becoming a big enough criminal to warrant a Null Void sentence, and later robbing a Khoros warlord. Punny Name: He was named to make a pun out of the name of his debut episode,OTTO Motives, which takes place at an auto show.

characters.name: Lord Transyl
characters.description: And I Must Scream:He himself suffers this fate, as Viktor puts him in a coffin floating in space and pushes said coffin in front of the sun. Back from the Dead: Vladats normally turn to ash when they die, making it impossible for DNA to be collected, and thus making that kind of revival impossible. Zs'Skayr got around this by using Lord Transyl's hand, which was apparently severed before death, and the power he stole from the Alpha Rune. Classical Movie Vampire: Envokes it by his looks. The Dragon: Becomes this to Zs'Skayr in the Galactic Monsters arc. Establishing Character Moment: The very first thing he does upon being resurrected is express hisneed to feed, then rush on Dr. Viktor and Kuphulu to devour their life force.

characters.name: Collectimus
characters.description: A mysterious entity who is aLoony FanBen 10 fan and intends to collect the real Ben 10 cast. Audience Surrogate: He mockingly represents a real lifeBen 10fan, specifically those who prefer theAlien Forceera. Great Gazoo: He's a very goofy character who also happens to have powerful reality distorting powers. Expy: His overall design, especially the shape of his helmet invokesGalactus. In particular the version fromThe Fantastic Four (1967). Loony Fan: He is a diehard Ben 10 fan, which compels him to collect therealBen 10 cast.

characters.name: Benevelon
characters.description: An alien who attempts to bring "peace" to Earth..by destroying everything with his killer robot. Affectionate Parody: He is a parody of the sci-fi B-movies from the 50's and 60's such asKillers From SpaceandSanta Claus Conquers the Martians, being renderedDeliberately Monochrometo match the black and white aesthetic of that era. His robot B.L.R.R.T. is basically a directExpyto GORT from theThe Day the Earth Stood Still (1951)though his name being an acronym more resemblesthe remake. Beware the Silly Ones: He may be hard to take seriously with his delusional speeches of preaching "peace", but he's still a very dangerous threat to Earth. Blue-and-Orange Morality:Defied. At first, it seems that Benevolen believes he is doing good and bringing about peace in his own deluded way. But as we get to see more of him, it becomes clear that while he is using the word "peace" wrong, he knows exactly what he is doing and shows sadistic relish at the prospect of ending all life on Earth. Deliberately Monochrome: His overall color scheme is a reference to the black and white B-movies of the 50's and 60's.

characters.name: Charles Zenith
characters.description: A galactic personality and host of the galaxy-wide hit "The Most Delicious Game" where every woman a contestant knows compete for his hand in marriage. Three guesses as to who he shanghais to be his latest contestant. His species is a Pugnavore, a race of green humanoids who feed off of conflict. Certainly explains the title of his show better. Emotion Eater: The main thing with his species, the Pugnavore. They feed off of drama, so Zenith creates constant conflict with his show to feed on. The fact there is an entireraceof this has disturbing implications. Great Gazoo: A goofy green alien with antennae and capable of doing plenty of strange things with just a snap of the fingers? It's surprising that it took several years for theBen 10franchise to make an homage to the character in the first place. It's unknown if all Pugnavores are like this though Attea's recognition of his kind and comments implied they are to a certain extent. Ink-Suit Actor: He looks almost like Charles Phoenix, glasses and all, but with green skin and hair, and antennae on his head. Jerkass: He kidnaps dozens of women, practically forces them to compete for Ben's hand in marriage, among them characters who are already in relationships, married or, most disturbing of all related to Ben (though Ben does get to eliminate the last one)Then keeps the losers to feed on off-season.
